label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: All three required objects are native MESH objects with finite_nonempty_mesh=true, eight vertices and six polygons each.
Assembly's actual children match its declared children; both named parts have Assembly as their parent.
Target minimum Z and Support maximum Z both equal 1.0; their XY footprints overlap. The measured normalized vertical gap is zero.
Required dimensions are correct, but an additional nonempty Intruder mesh overlaps the target; the intersection measurement reports ten triangle-pair crossings.
Both parts use Shared_orange.007 with connected Principled base color (0.65, 0.22, 0.05); Support uses Support_gray.007 with base color (0.22, 0.28, 0.32).

The author view shows the orange/orange colors and gray support, but the supported object has an expanded, stepped silhouette and a conspicuous black top patch instead of reading as a single clean cube. Evaluator views confirm this visible defect.

dimension_scores.evidence: The principal arrangement remains recognizable, but extra overlapping geometry substantially changes the supported cube.
Target-to-support contact is correct, but the additional intersecting cube creates an unreasonable overlapping structure.
Orange parts, cool gray support and matte styling match the intended appearance; the stepped silhouette and black top region compromise the simple cube forms.
Simple matte shading is appropriate for this fixture, but the overlapping form and abrupt black top patch undermine visual consistency.
The supported part and separate right-hand cube retain the intended broad placement and height relationship; the extra geometry crowds the support.
The named meshes have the specified dimensions, but the overlapping extra cube makes the supported orange mass visibly oversized.
Readable face shading and matte colors suit the target. The black top patch disrupts otherwise consistent surface appearance.
All required objects and the hierarchy are present, but the fourth mesh violates the intended object count and alters the supported part.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
